tools.name: check_actions_cost
tools.description: Reads the saved spendtron report for this API key: workflows priced per job at current GitHub runner rates, plus corroborated workflow changes. Does not scan GitHub itself. Open /report to build or refresh the sample.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_actions_cost" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Ranks your GitHub org's Actions workflows and repos by real compute cost, using your account's spendtron connection (no arguments needed — identified by your API key)." → after: "Reads the saved spendtron report for this API key: workflows priced per job at current GitHub runner rates, plus corroborated workflow changes. Does not scan GitHub itself. Open /report to build or refresh the sample."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
